common_prompt: Create one new finished 2D painted fantasy merchant-location environment concept, landscape 16:9, using the supplied images as ART DIRECTION REFERENCES ONLY. Reference 1 defines the environment painting, three-quarter elevated camera, materials and light. Reference 2 defines chunky sculpted silhouettes, faceted weathered grey stone, soft moss and aged bronze; DO NOT depict its golem or any other character. The result must be a NEW SHOP MAP with its own architecture and layout, not the reference library with a few objects added. Match the confident dark drawn contours, broad painterly shaded color planes, handmade asymmetrical proportions, blue-slate masonry, olive moss, gnarled roots, oxidized bronze fittings, restrained turquoise magic and intimate amber candlelight. The world feels ancient, magical, inhabited and welcoming, with believable material wear. A beautiful illustrated RPG background with excellent readability at gameplay scale, neither photorealistic nor a generic glossy 3D render. Elevated three-quarter game camera, looking down enough to read all counters and floor paths, coherent parallel floor axes, no visible sky or horizon. Full-bleed environment fills the landscape frame, not an isolated floating miniature. Design for future point-and-click shopping: broad connected dry stone walkways from the lower foreground to every counter; 40 to 50 percent visually quiet walking and approach space; clearly separated merchandise silhouettes; unobstructed empty floor behind counters for future shopkeeper placement. Make about four potential object-interaction destinations visually distinct, with gentle local lighting rather than UI effects. Tall structures remain along back and sides, foreground objects low and cropped only at the frame edges. Every counter has an accessible customer side. Low overall clutter, detail concentrated in useful clusters, strongly readable shape hierarchy. NO people, NO humanoids, NO golems, NO creatures, NO character statues, NO faces, NO UI, NO labels, NO readable text, NO prices, NO icons, NO cursor, NO selection outline, NO grid, NO watermark, NO collage or split panels. No huge luminous portal that competes with the merchandise. Render one complete coherent scene.

concepts.title: Le Comptoir des archives
concepts.description_fr: Une boutique de reliques aménagée dans une bibliothèque ancienne. Comptoir en L, trois présentoirs isolés et lumière turquoise discrète au fond.
concepts.variant_prompt: VARIANT A — THE ARCHIVE RELIC SHOP. An intimate rectangular chamber in the same ancient library complex as reference 1, now a carefully organized antiquarian shop. A solid dark oak L-shaped counter sits along the upper-right wall, its lower customer side fully visible, with broad empty standing space behind it. Upper-left wall has tall recessed bookshelves between massive mossy blue-grey stone piers. Three LOW, generously separated merchandise displays around the outer edges: one open jewel-bound grimoire on a slanted reading stand at left-middle; one open brass-inlaid chest holding an ancient key at right-middle; one faceted turquoise crystal in a bronze mount on a low square pedestal near the back-left. A broad gently curving uninterrupted floor aisle enters from bottom-center and connects every display to the counter. Warm clusters of candles illuminate parchment, polished wood and brass. A tiny recessed cyan crystal lamp in a rear arch gives cool depth, not a portal. Roots and one motionless bronze wheel decorate the distant wall. Restrained palette of midnight blue, olive, amber and cyan; the most intimate and bookish of the three concepts. No bodies, mannequins or suits of armor. The central aisle is quiet, dry and clear. Present as a compelling premium game environment painting.

concepts.title: La Halle sous les racines
concepts.description_fr: Un petit bazar souterrain sous des racines monumentales. Trois étals distincts entourent une place praticable et une fontaine basse.
concepts.variant_prompt: VARIANT B — THE ROOTBOUND UNDERGROUND BAZAAR. A wider underground market hall under enormous weathered stone arches bound by ancient roots. Three small distinct empty stalls arranged in a shallow horseshoe around an open stone plaza, all merchandise facing the camera and accessible from the plaza: upper-left a faded burgundy cloth awning over a low weapon-and-shield counter, displaying one shield and a horizontal sword with no human-shaped armor or mannequins; upper-middle a stone-arched provisions shop with neat baskets and pottery amphorae; upper-right a timber-and-bronze kiosk selling a few magical artifacts. Short shallow stall roofs never hide the merchandise or standing space behind the counters. A very LOW small polygonal fountain slightly left of center with a dim turquoise spring, surrounded by a broad dry circular walking route; the fountain occupies less than 8 percent of the image and does not block the entry from the lower center. Peripheral narrow cyan water channel with distinct solid stone lip, no flooded walking ground. Huge roots and old bronze gears frame only the outer walls. Amber hanging lanterns mark the three vendors. Subdued teal-grey stone, olive vegetation, aged bronze, oxblood awning. The scale is that of three intimate shops sharing a room, not a distant city or overwhelming sprawling marketplace. Generous clear foreground, legible individual merchandise and pathways.

concepts.title: L’Apothicairerie du bassin
concepts.description_fr: Une échoppe d’alchimie organique et chaleureuse. Comptoir courbe, fioles espacées, plantes et distillateur de bronze autour d’un bassin discret.
concepts.variant_prompt: VARIANT C — THE SPRING APOTHECARY. A cozy near-circular alchemist shop built into an old stone cistern, with organic irregular moss-covered masonry and gnarled roots curving over the rear wall. At back-right a shallow stone basin holds softly luminous cyan liquid, connected to a beautifully simple copper-and-bronze distillation apparatus on a substantial side workbench. A curved dark wooden counter follows the upper-left perimeter; behind it, clearly visible empty space for a future shopkeeper. Three uncluttered merchandise destinations: a light parchment-lined tray bearing THREE large separated potion bottles on the counter, a compact shelf of ingredient jars at left-middle, and the bronze still at right-middle. Muted plum and amber contents in most bottles; only two small potions glow cyan. Dried herbs hang in small separated bundles high on the rear wall. Rounded carved stones, brass fittings, mossy niches and one small gear evoke the golem's craftsmanship without depicting any figure. A broad unobstructed crescent of dry stone walking floor runs from bottom-center to all stations; no canal cuts across it. Amber warmth dominates with olive, dark plum and slate-blue shadows; cyan is a very restrained secondary accent at the back. The most organic and artisanal of the three concepts, beautiful contained atmosphere, without clutter or steam hiding the objects.
